issue: chunks(values,size) returns consecutive nonempty lists including a short tail. Reject size <= 0 with ValueError.
source:
def chunks(values, size):
    return [values[i:i+size] for i in range(0, len(values)-size+1, size)]

issue: split_fields(text) splits on unescaped commas. Backslash escapes any next character. Preserve empty fields and a trailing literal backslash.
hidden_tests:
assert m.split_fields("") == [""]
assert m.split_fields(",a,,") == ["","a","",""]
assert m.split_fields("a"+chr(92)) == ["a"+chr(92)]
assert m.split_fields(chr(92)*2+",b") == [chr(92),"b"]

issue: merge(intervals) sorts closed integer intervals then merges overlapping or adjacent intervals. Do not mutate input. Empty input returns [].
hidden_tests:
x=[[8,9],[1,10],[2,3]]
y=[v[:] for v in x]
assert m.merge(x) == [[1,10]]
assert x == y
assert m.merge([]) == []
assert m.merge([[1,1],[3,3]]) == [[1,1],[3,3]]

issue: get_path(data,path,default=None) follows dot-separated dictionary keys. Return default on a missing key or non-dict intermediate. Preserve falsey values. Empty path returns data.
hidden_tests:
assert m.get_path({"a":False},"a",True) is False
assert m.get_path({"a":None},"a",8) is None
assert m.get_path({"a":3},"a.b",9) == 9
assert m.get_path({},"x.y",4) == 4
assert m.get_path({"a":1},"") == {"a":1}

issue: latest(events) returns the last event per id by timestamp; on equal timestamps the later input wins. Return dictionary id -> original event. Handle empty input.

order_jobs(dependencies) returns a valid topological ordering, including names mentioned only as dependencies. A job must follow all its dependencies. Raise ValueError on any cycle, including disconnected cycles. Empty input returns [].
